meta.title: Noezz Coffee – Phin coffee & rooftop in Da Nang
meta.description: Vietnamese coffee shop in An Thuong, Da Nang: phin coffee, salted cream coffee, fruit teas and pastries baked every morning.

story.title: Vietnamese coffee, made our way.
story.text: Noezz Coffee sits on the ground floor and rooftop of Noezz Homestay in An Thuong. We roast every week, pour phin for our morning regulars and keep a quiet corner for people who need to work.
